scope: Theorem 12.7 (Terminal periodic system) of the manuscript “Virtual compact specialness of hyperbolic one-relator groups” (preprints/Virtual-compact-specialness-of-hyperbolic-one-relator-groups-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 258 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a6c45541e6943005), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 89. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Starting with the system of Proposition 9.9, finitely many cyclic-closure and end-enlargement rounds produce an admissible strict malnor- mal quasiconvex virtually compact special system {Dd}, with Sd = Dd ∩ L, and a folded tree b T having all the conclusions of Corollary 11.7. The associated monotone lines ℓd of distinct objects share no end. Actual long noncyclic path stabilizers remain captured, the kernels still detect all noncyclic subgroups, and their joint homology budget is at most k − 1.
